answer_1.quote: We employ CoIN, a MCIT benchmark with numerous vision-language instruction datasets ... includes OCRVQA, GQA, ImageNet, ScienceQA, Vizwiz, TextVQA, VQAv2 and RefCoco. ... Our method can maintain performance on diverse previous tasks, keep knowledge from multimodality and answer challenging questions requiring comprehensive understanding correctly.
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual answers to multimodal prompts (e.g., VQA answers, grounding descriptions)

answer_2.quote: We measure each dataset using metrics Last (performance after sequential training on all tasks...), Backward Transfer (B) and Mean Accuracy (M).
